# NurdiansyahLabs

> NurdiansyahLabs is an enterprise software engineering studio, system architecture consultancy, and digital portfolio operated by Nurdiansyah (Enterprise Software Engineer & Systems Architect). It engineers production-grade distributed applications, custom operational ERPs, and end-to-end Full SDLC systems.

## Technology Stack & Engineering Standards
- Frontend: React 18, Vite, Progressive Web Apps (PWA), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Python 3.13, Flask 3.1.3 (Modular Monolith & Event-Driven Architecture), Node.js, RESTful APIs
- Database & Storage: PostgreSQL 13/15, MySQL 8.0, Redis Cache, SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM, Alembic Migrations, 3NF Normalization
- DevOps & Deployment: Docker Containers, Linux, Nginx/LiteSpeed, Phusion Passenger WSGI, Zero-Downtime Rolling Deploys
- Engineering Methodologies: Full SDLC, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Automated Testing (Unit, Integration, E2E), CI/CD Automation

## Key Showcase Projects & Enterprise Systems
- Primatera Poultry ERP: End-to-end commercial agrobusiness ERP tracking flock feed conversion ratio (FCR), mortality telemetry, coop cashflow economics, and warehouse feed stock.
- LogiStack Warehouse WMS: Production warehouse management system handling SKU inventory matrices, bin locations, and inbound/outbound shipping manifests.
- Koperasi POS System: Distributed offline-first retail & cooperative point of sale with receipt printing, cashier role permissions, and inventory reconciliation.
- Batam Rental Mobil PWA: Online fleet dispatch and automated rental reservation progressive web application.
- Smart Vision AI: Computer vision edge inference and defect detection system.

## Core Enterprise Services
1. Enterprise Software Engineering & Full SDLC: End-to-end software lifecycle delivery—from business domain modeling and architecture blueprints to production deployment and APM monitoring.
2. Custom ERP & Operational Systems: Bespoke business management software eliminating paper logs and spreadsheet silos for multi-branch retail, logistics, and agriculture.
3. Technical Architecture Advisory & Code Audit: System scalability reviews, database concurrency optimization, SQL bottleneck mitigation, and technical debt reduction for CTOs and founders.
4. Business Intelligence & Data Pipelines: Interactive reporting dashboards (Tableau, Power BI, React Charts) with automated data cleaning and scheduled ETL pipelines.
